parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paging query. For example, set this parameter to **1** to return the first page of results.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records displayed on each page.
